hazard: upstream grain is one row per paragraph and downstream grain is one row per element; an element spanning two paragraphs and a paragraph carrying two elements both read as valid rows on either side, so the cardinality mismatch is invisible to both node suites
strictness is carried only in the verbatim phrasing; any normalisation between these nodes silently converts lt to lte and the divergence appears at exactly one input value per cap, the boundary

upstream promises an opaque stable id and downstream must not re-derive an address from ordinal; a positional address resolves correctly until the first insertion and then re-points every state-grounded claim with no error
a one-to-one relation crossing this edge produces arithmetic that invalidates categorical exclusions, and it passes every node-local test because the fixture data need not overlap
an input the ontology does not carry is supplied by a named constant at the call site; the function returns a correct answer for the current seed and the missing binding is invisible to every test
a comparison performed across mismatched units, or with strictness taken from a sibling constraint, is wrong at the boundary only; both sides individually type-check

resolution against a path that resolves by position, or a verifier that searches for a matching value rather than resolving a named path, would pass a sentence true of the geometric union and false of the treatment sum
the page anchor must survive into the claim's source_id or the verifier checks a substring against the wrong page and passes for the wrong reason
element identity must be the same object on both sides across an insertion, or closure holds against a set the manifest is no longer describing
freshness is computed from changed_at per path; a path whose change events are not recorded reads as never changed and every value derived from it reads as fresh forever

a verdict stamped before emitted_at is a statement about a state that may have moved; reusing it for a state-grounded claim is the failure the freshness clause exists for, and it renders identically to a fresh one
the kind is declared by the producer; a claim arriving with no kind must be refused rather than defaulted to the weaker check, and the default is the cheapest thing to write on either side
the manifest is computed at emission and the screen displays continuously; a screen reading a manifest field it did not declare a dependency on shows a value the manifest has since superseded

probed in a parallel build: the generated OSDK client emits a function version decoupled from the import list, silently, with no error; and the React hook strips optionality from every query parameter, so an absent optional parameter cannot be expressed without a cast

one element may need several slots and one slot may contribute to several elements; the cardinality is many-to-many and both sides read as valid rows under a one-to-one mapping, so an EIS impacts element collapses to a single unroutable slot with no error
a tri-state flag crossing into a candidate as a boolean prints 'not subject to a non-final judicial action' as a positive statement about an authority nobody checked

the notice of intent's per-issue expected-impacts register must exist at notice publication, long before the document it announces; a downstream node that builds it at document time satisfies its own guarantee and publishes a notice whose issue list nothing can later be checked against

an expert_required slot arriving with no qualification or no lead time produces an assignment nobody can act on, and it reads as routed; the queue's own suite cannot see a field the register failed to supply

the disposition boundary is the whole guard: a drafter that reads a slot as drafted when the register froze it expert_required fills a cultural or wildlife section with model prose, and every downstream count reads complete
the adequacy statement is drafted from a candidate whose prongs are deliberately unresolved; a drafter that reads an unresolved prong as agreement writes a sentence asserting sameness no human judged

the no-additional-alternatives narrative is producible only from the modification log; a drafter reaching this edge without the log writes a fluent rationale citing nothing, and the sentence looks the same either way

coverage accounting is per disposition; a slot counted under a disposition other than the one frozen for it lets work migrate between drafted, record-supplied and expert-required while the total stays constant and the manifest reads complete

an explicit none-found and a silent absence are different states and arrive over the same edge; and a privileged record item incorporated by reference unredacted is a disclosure the document cannot take back
certifying statements must be deterministic; a model reachable across this edge produces a fluent paraphrase of a sworn certification, which is the one place in the document a reader cannot audit
a coverage-gap report and a received artifact both arrive as content on this edge; counting the first as a fill ships a section describing what is missing from a study nobody has done

the page anchor must survive into the attestation or the directory asserts that a named holder prepared a document at a page that does not name them, which is a claim about a real party that nobody can check

a holder crossing this edge without channel provenance, or an individual crossing where only an organisation is permitted, produces an assignment that looks routed and is a privacy exposure; and a request package missing the element citations returns an artifact nobody can gap-check against what was asked for
